title: Open the Starter Gate
story: The door controller uses a conditional to decide whether there is enough fuel.
lesson: if runs a block only when its condition is true. >= means greater than or equal to.
objective: With fuel = 12, use an if/else statement to print READY when fuel >= 10, otherwise WAIT.
starter_code:
fuel = 12
# Use if/else to print READY or WAIT.
hint: Use if fuel >= 10: and an else: block; indent each print call.
